story_title: TRUSTBANK Deploys OpenAI-Powered Agents to Personalize Japan's Furusato Nozei Gifts
caption:
TRUSTBANK paired with AI development firm Recursive to launch Choice AI, an OpenAI-powered agent designed to transform Japan's Furusato Nozei gift discovery.

Instead of sifting through massive static catalogs using complex filters, users converse with an AI agent to discover regional gifts tailored to their exact intent.

Is agentic curation the future of complex e-commerce platforms? Let us know below.
